question: In a certain code language, 'LABOR' is written as 'RALOB'. How will 'EARLY' be written in that language?
solution:
The logic followed here is :-

'LABOR' is written as 'RALOB'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b097c2573f21c0e770328f8ccd8ac3af6f8d957d6a72773017d41d9741d33f6f.png] 

Similarly,

'EARLY' will be written as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9afae0eb25bdd84596203b0bb73b2f989245033342a7e595db02cf2aab2432b2.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"YAELR".**
